title: Mass Air Flow Sensor Circuit Extended
shortDescription: Extended diagnostic for MAF sensor circuit malfunction.
fullDescription:
P0100 sets when the PCM detects an abnormal Mass Air Flow sensor signal. The extended diagnostic path uses MAF gram-per-second values cross-referenced against MAP and throttle position data to identify intermittent or drifted sensors.

Most MAF issues stem from contamination, wiring corrosion, or hot-wire damage. A clogged or torn intake filter can also produce out-of-range readings.

For a complete fix, capture MAF data during a snap-throttle test and compare against expected values for engine displacement.
safetyImpact: Drivability and emissions affected; possible stalling.

fixSteps.title: Inspect intake
fixSteps.instruction: Check intake boot for cracks or tears.

fixSteps.title: Snap-throttle test
fixSteps.instruction: Watch g/s value during sudden throttle.

title: MAF Sensor Range/Performance Extended
shortDescription: MAF sensor reading outside expected range under load.
fullDescription:
P0101 indicates the MAF signal is plausible but does not match expected values for current engine load and RPM. Common on engines with intake leaks or aged sensors.

Extended path correlates MAF g/s with calculated load to find the discrepancy window.

title: MAF Sensor Circuit Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0102 sets with low MAF signal voltage. Often due to a disconnected sensor, severed signal wire, or a heavily contaminated hot-wire element.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Fit new sensor if signal still low.

title: MAF Sensor Circuit High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0103 sets when MAF signal exceeds expected maximum. Causes include shorted-to-power signal wire or a failed sensor IC.

faq.a: Yes if rich for long time.

title: MAP/Barometric Pressure Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0105 sets when the manifold absolute pressure or barometric pressure circuit fails performance check. Extended path verifies sensor at key-on, idle, and WOT against published voltage tables.

fixSteps.title: Voltage check
fixSteps.instruction: Verify KOEO voltage matches baro spec.

title: MAP Sensor Range/Performance Extended
shortDescription: MAP signal not tracking with load.
fullDescription: P0106 sets when MAP value disagrees with throttle and engine load. Extended path watches MAP across throttle sweeps to detect drift.

title: MAP Sensor Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0107 sets with MAP voltage below threshold, typical of disconnected sensor or short to ground.

title: MAP Sensor High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0108 sets with MAP voltage above threshold, suggesting open circuit or shorted-to-power.

title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0110 sets on IAT circuit fault. Extended path correlates IAT to ECT after a cold soak — values should be within 5C.

title: IAT Sensor Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0112 sets when IAT voltage suggests temperature below plausibility. Short to ground or sensor failure.

title: IAT Sensor High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0113 sets with IAT voltage exceeding maximum. Open circuit common.

title: Engine Coolant Temp Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0115 sets when ECT signal is invalid. Extended path verifies sensor R vs T curve at known temperatures.
safetyImpact: Cooling fan logic, fuel mixture impacted.

title: ECT Sensor Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0117 sets with ECT voltage below limit. Sensor short or failure suspected.

title: ECT Sensor High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0118 sets with ECT voltage above limit. Open circuit common.

title: Throttle Position Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0120 sets when throttle position signal A is invalid. Extended path scope-tests TPS sweep from idle to WOT for dropouts.

fixSteps.title: Sweep test
fixSteps.instruction: Scope TPS during slow throttle sweep.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Fit new throttle body or TPS.

title: TPS Sensor A Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0122 sets when TPS A signal is below the minimum. Often a worn carbon track or short to ground.

title: TPS Sensor A High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0123 sets with high TPS A signal. Short to power or open ground common.

title: Insufficient Coolant Temp for Closed Loop Extended
shortDescription: Engine slow to reach closed-loop temp.
fullDescription: P0125 sets when engine takes longer than expected to reach closed-loop temperature. Often a stuck-open thermostat.

title: Coolant Below Thermostat Regulating Temp Extended
shortDescription: Coolant fails to reach regulating temperature.
fullDescription: P0128 sets when coolant doesn't reach minimum operating temperature within prescribed time. Almost always a stuck-open thermostat in cold weather.

title: O2 Sensor Circuit Bank 1 Sensor 1 Extended
shortDescription: Upstream O2 Bank 1 Sensor 1 circuit fault.
fullDescription: P0130 indicates upstream B1S1 oxygen sensor circuit malfunction. Extended path examines waveform amplitude and frequency over 30 seconds at 2500 RPM.

title: Cylinder 3 Injector Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0270 sets when injector 3 control circuit voltage is below threshold. Typical: shorted injector winding or harness short to ground.

title: Cylinder 3 Injector Circuit High Extended
fullDescription: P0271 sets when injector 3 control circuit voltage exceeds limit. Often open injector winding or open control wire.

title: Cylinder 4 Injector Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0272 sets when injector 4 control circuit voltage is below threshold.

title: Cylinder 4 Injector Circuit High Extended
fullDescription: P0273 sets when injector 4 control voltage exceeds limit. Open winding common.

title: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0274 covers cyl 5 injector low circuit fault.

title: Cylinder 5 Injector Circuit High Extended
fullDescription: P0275 covers cyl 5 injector circuit high.

title: Cylinder 6 Injector Circuit Low Extended
fullDescription: P0276 covers cyl 6 injector circuit low.

title: Cylinder 6 Injector Circuit High Extended
fullDescription: P0277 covers cyl 6 injector circuit high.

title: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Extended
fullDescription: P0300 sets when the PCM detects multiple-cylinder misfires within a window. Extended path uses misfire counters per cylinder to find the worst offender.

title: Cylinder 1 Misfire Detected Extended
fullDescription: P0301 indicates cyl 1 misfire. Extended path swaps coil/injector/plug to a known-good cylinder to follow the fault.

title: Misfire During Startup First 1000 Revs Extended
fullDescription: P0316 sets when misfire occurs during cold-start cranking phase. Often a Ford-specific symptom of cam phaser issues.

title: Ignition/Distributor Engine Speed Input Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0320 sets when crank/cam reference signal to PCM is missing or distorted. Extended path scopes the sensor signal during cranking.

title: Knock Sensor 1 Circuit Bank 1 Extended
fullDescription: P0325 sets when knock sensor 1 signal is invalid. Extended path verifies sensor with controlled tap test while monitoring scan tool.
safetyImpact: Loss of timing advance, reduced power.

title: Knock Sensor 1 Range/Performance Bank 1
shortDescription: Knock sensor 1 signal out of range.
fullDescription: P0326 sets when knock sensor 1 signal level is plausible but outside expected window for engine load.

title: Knock Sensor 2 Circuit Bank 2 Extended
fullDescription: P0330 covers Bank 2 knock sensor circuit fault on V engines. Extended path mirrors P0325 procedure.

title: Knock Sensor 2 Range/Performance Bank 2
fullDescription: P0332 covers Bank 2 sensor range fault. Diagnose like P0326.

title: EVAP Pressure Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0450 sets when the EVAP pressure sensor signal is invalid. Extended path captures sensor voltage during purge cycle.

title: EVAP Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
fullDescription: P0451 sets when sensor reading does not change as expected during purge or vent cycles.

title: EVAP Pressure Sensor Low Input Extended
fullDescription: P0452 sets when EVAP pressure sensor signal voltage is below threshold.

title: EVAP Pressure Sensor High Input Extended
fullDescription: P0453 sets when sensor signal exceeds maximum. Open circuit common.

title: EVAP Large Leak Detected Extended
shortDescription: Large EVAP leak — typically a loose gas cap.
fullDescription: P0455 sets when EVAP system can't hold pressure/vacuum. Extended path uses smoke machine to locate leak.

title: EVAP Very Small Leak Detected Extended
fullDescription: P0456 sets when system detects leak smaller than 0.020 inches. Often the hardest leak to find — extended path uses pressurized smoke and UV dye.

title: EVAP Leak Detected Loose Fuel Cap Extended
shortDescription: EVAP leak indicates loose fuel cap.
fullDescription: P0457 specifically points to a loose or missing fuel cap.

faq.a: Yes — may take a few drives to clear.

title: Cooling Fan 1 Control Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0480 sets when fan 1 control circuit fails. Extended path verifies relay drive, fuse, and motor.

faq.a: Yes — pull over if temp climbs.

title: Cooling Fan 2 Control Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0481 covers fan 2 control fault, common on dual-fan systems.

title: EVAP System Flow During Non-Purge Extended
shortDescription: EVAP flow when purge not commanded.
fullDescription: P0496 sets when EVAP flow detected with purge solenoid off. Usually a stuck-open purge valve.

fixSteps.title: Pinch hose
fixSteps.instruction: Pinch purge hose; if idle improves, valve leaks.

title: EVAP Low Flow Extended
fullDescription: P0497 sets when EVAP flow is below expected during purge. Often blocked purge line or stuck-closed valve.

title: EVAP Vent Valve Control Circuit Low
shortDescription: EVAP vent valve circuit reads low.
fullDescription: P0498 sets with vent valve control voltage below threshold. Short to ground common.

title: EVAP Vent Valve Control Circuit High
shortDescription: EVAP vent valve circuit reads high.
fullDescription: P0499 sets with vent valve voltage above limit. Open circuit common.

title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0500 sets when VSS signal is missing or implausible. Extended path verifies signal at PCM with vehicle on lift in gear.

fixSteps.title: Signal test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify signal at PCM with wheel rotating.

faq.a: Modern vehicles use ABS wheel speeds.

title: Transmission Control System Malfunction Extended
shortDescription: Generic TCM fault — see TCM-stored codes.
fullDescription: P0700 is an informational code requesting that the technician retrieve transmission-specific codes from the TCM. Extended path is to scan the TCM module separately.

title: Transmission Control System Range/Performance Extended
fullDescription: P0701 sets when TCM detects internal range/performance fault. Extended path looks at adapt values.

title: Transmission Fluid Temp Sensor Circuit Extended
shortDescription: Trans fluid temp sensor circuit fault.
fullDescription: P0710 sets when ATF temperature sensor signal is invalid. Often the TFT sensor is internal to the valve body or part of the solenoid harness.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Fit new TFT or solenoid pack.

title: Trans Fluid Temp Sensor Range/Performance
fullDescription: P0711 sets when TFT signal is plausible but doesn't change with operation. Sensor drift suspected.

title: Trans Fluid Temp Sensor Low Input
fullDescription: P0712 sets with TFT signal below threshold. Short to ground common.

title: Trans Fluid Temp Sensor High Input
fullDescription: P0713 sets with TFT signal above threshold. Open circuit common.

title: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0715 sets when input/turbine speed sensor signal is invalid. Critical for shift logic.

title: Output Speed Sensor Circuit Extended
fullDescription: P0720 sets when output speed sensor signal is invalid. Used by TCM for gear ratio calculations.

title: Engine Speed Input Circuit Extended
shortDescription: Engine speed input to TCM circuit.
fullDescription: P0725 sets when TCM cannot read engine RPM signal from the PCM. Often a CAN/communication issue.

title: Incorrect Gear Ratio Extended
fullDescription: P0730 sets when actual gear ratio differs from commanded. Internal slippage or sensor fault suspected.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Solenoid pack or rebuild as needed.
